summary.short: Norway's Electronic Communications Act (ekomloven), in force from 1 January 2025, replaces the 2003 Act. It regulates communications networks and services and data centres. Data centre operators must register before operating and meet security and preparedness duties.
summary.long: The Electronic Communications Act (ekomloven) replaces the 2003 Act. Under §18-1 it applies from 1 January 2025, with the King able to set different entry dates for individual provisions. It governs electronic communications networks and services, frequencies, numbering and data centres (§§1-1, 1-2). Data centre operators must register with the ministry before starting operations (§3-7). They must provide data centre services with security and preparedness, document their security level, and may be subject to ministry orders. The state compensates certain extra national-security measures. In emergencies, operators must carry out necessary usage restrictions (§3-8), and the ministry may request police certificates for certain staff (§3-9). Network and service providers face security and incident-reporting duties (§§3-1 to 3-3), privacy and cookie-consent rules (§§3-10, 3-15), IP address retention for twelve months (§3-13), consumer information and contract rules (Chapter 4), and access obligations for providers with significant market power (Chapters 6 to 10). Enforcement includes ministry orders, coercive fines, administrative fines (§15-12) and criminal penalties of fines or up to one year's imprisonment (§15-14). The text does not state fine amounts.

notes: No enabling act is cited, so there is no legal_basis row. The header's EEA reference list also names Decision 676/2002/EF, Directive 2002/77/EF, Regulation (EU) 2022/612, Regulation (EU) 2018/1971, Directive 2002/58/EF and Regulation (EU) 2015/2120; they are not tied to specific provisions and are not coded as separate rows. Target instrument IDs are empty where no registry ID is known. The section_status relations entry is a required schema placeholder; relations are present in the array. Text inconsistency: the metadata field 'Sist endret' gives LOV-2025-12-22-128 from 01.07.2026, but § 2-12 cites a later amendment (lov 19 juni 2026 nr. 48). Reader note: § 3-7 allows data-centre operation once registration is completed, while § 2-1 allows telecom providers to start when registration is sent.
